items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: My mother's uncle directed the New York Symphony, his name was Chavez, C-H-V-E-Z, Carlos Chavez.

ctx.x: And what part of town were you born in?

Well, now I'll tell you, that's a long story, since you asked me a question. Yeah, okay. Now, truth is speaking, I don't believe in lying about nothing I'd say. So, you asked me kind of a sort of a first question. I said, no, as a matter of fact, I wasn't born here. I wasn't born, I wasn't born here, you see? I was born in Mexico. In Mexico? Right. What part? Oh, about 100 miles from Mexico City, and Jalisco. Oh, that's where all the Mariachis came from. Where I saw her, where I saw her, where I saw her. See, my…
Oh, I'm not who he is.
